description:
Use this when the user wants to search a long video for a topic by meaning before clipping: "where do I talk
about the new game", "when did chat go wild". Returns job_id; once job_status says done, get_moments gives
time ranges with a quote.
Not for: cutting clips straight away (find_clips, clip_range) or finding a video by name (search). Spends
Horizon Units, as much as reading the whole video: call estimate_hu first, show the number and pass the
approved amount as max_hu (a failed search gives it back; a video analysed once is not charged again).

count.description: How many matches to return, 1 to 10.

max_hu.description: Horizon Units the user approved, from estimate_hu; a higher cost is refused.

project_id.description: Id of the video, from list_projects.

request_key.description: Optional unique string; repeating it returns the same job.

topic.description: What to look for, in plain words, e.g. "the new game" or "funny bits".

name: find_moments
title: Find moments
